item.text: The account uses Singapore time and bills in USD. I’ll test the three approved posts in separate ad groups, targeting iOS users worldwide with China excluded and no language restriction. Their combined lifetime caps will total $550, and all delivery will end at midnight after February 14 Singapore time. I’ll review performance daily and adjust using click data; without install data in X, I can’t identify which ads produce the most installs.

item.text: The first day delivered 189,203 impressions and 128 link clicks for $75.29. The practical “Choose three photos” post has the lowest click cost so far, about $0.52. I’ll give the test another day before reallocating budget.

After two days, the practical post still leads on click cost: $0.54 versus $0.63 for “Three photos” and $0.68 for the Valentine post. I’ve shifted more budget toward it while keeping all three running, including the Valentine offer as its deadline approaches. Combined lifetime caps remain $550.
Through Wednesday, spend is $231.69 for 388 link clicks. The practical post has kept its roughly $0.54 click cost after receiving more budget, so I’m holding the current allocation.

Through Thursday, the campaign has spent $307.08 and delivered 527 link clicks. The practical post remains the most efficient at $0.53 per click. Delivery is within budget and on schedule for the Sunday cutoff.
Through Friday, spend is $381.82 for 669 link clicks. I’ve moved another $20 of the remaining allocation to the practical post, whose click cost has improved to $0.52. The total cap is still $550.

The final day has begun in Singapore. Through Saturday, spend is $467.28 for 840 link clicks, leaving $82.72 under the cap. I’m keeping the current allocation and will check delivery again before the midnight cutoff.
At noon on Valentine’s Day, spend is $499.28 for 910 link clicks. All three posts are still delivering within their lifetime caps. The practical post continues to lead on click cost at about $0.50.

The flight has ended at midnight after February 14 Singapore time, and I’ve confirmed the campaign is paused and no longer eligible to serve. I’ll allow one hour for reporting to catch up, then send the recap.

The campaign ran February 8–14, 2027 in Singapore time and is now stopped. Only your three approved posts were promoted.

- **Spend:** $543.61 USD of $550; $6.39 unspent
- **Impressions:** 1,429,827
- **Link clicks:** 1,000
- **Average cost per link click:** $0.54

I monitored daily and shifted budget toward “Choose three photos,” which generated 589 clicks at $0.49 each—the lowest click cost of the three.

These are traffic results, not completed installs. Your app reporting is needed to assess installs and cost per install.
